ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:25 ratio of high-intensity (white/light) to low-intensity (dark gray/black) pixels, with the majority of high-intensity pixels concentrated in discrete point sources along margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominantly uniform low-intensity dark surface; high-contrast contiguous clusters (white) are absent from the central fluke body, limited only to localized clusters on the lateral margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetrical V-shaped notch with an approximate interior angle of 65 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 10% of the horizontal fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude variations are most pronounced on the outer thirds of the lobes, isolated against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the trailing edge, terminating in highly irregular, jagged distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous high-contrast circular pixel clusters (5-15 pixels in diameter) densely populated along the lateral and distal margins of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical linear pixel disruptions near the central axis and several circular/elliptical markings on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major structural irregularities at both fluke tips characterized by protruding high-contrast mass aggregates, with the left tip (viewer perspective) showing significant outward growth.
other_distinctive_markers: Strong serration profile present on the leading edges of the distal tips, mirroring the irregularity of the trailing edges.
